name: harness-event-question-requested

request.prompt: Which workspace should the run use?

questions.prompt: Which workspace should the run use?

notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:398 and 297-327. A question carries a flat prompt/options pair and optionally the per-question items; DSH maps user-questions/request to a best-effort event without seq, joins the question texts into prompt and takes the first item's option labels (DSHRemoteHarness.swift:410-422). No seq means it is never replayed after a resume.
